title: Workable - recruiting and HR software
description: Applicant tracking (ATS), hiring workflows, and HR tools for teams that need to source, evaluate, and hire candidates at scale.
tags: ATS, applicant tracking system, recruiting software, HR software, HRIS, hiring, talent acquisition, Workable AI

# Workable | All-in-one HR software

> Workable is recruiting and HR software used to find, evaluate, and hire candidates and to run core HR workflows. It goes beyond a basic ATS: teams use it for sourcing, pipeline management, collaboration, reporting, and (where offered) AI-assisted hiring tasks. The public marketing site is primarily in English; product help and documentation live on Workable Help Center.

## Important notes

- Workable is B2B SaaS for employers and HR teams, not a general job board for candidates (candidate-facing experiences may use separate domains such as jobs hosted by employers).
- Pricing, plans, and feature availability can change; use the Pricing page and official help articles for current detail.
- For account-specific or contractual questions, prefer official policies and support channels over blog or third-party summaries.

## Core product & marketing

- [Home](https://www.workable.com/): Primary entry point for the product story, social proof, and calls to action.
- [Features](https://www.workable.com/features): Overview of recruiting and HR capabilities (sourcing, pipeline, collaboration, automation, reporting, integrations context).
- [Pricing](https://www.workable.com/pricing): Plans, packaging, and how to understand what is included commercially.
- [Workable AI](https://www.workable.com/workable-ai): How AI is positioned in the product (assistive workflows, not a substitute for human hiring decisions).
- [Security](https://www.workable.com/security): Security posture, trust, and related commitments as presented to prospects and customers.
- [Free trial](https://www.workable.com/free-trial): How to start a trial of the product from the marketing site.

## Tools & generators (marketing)

- [Job description generator](https://www.workable.com/job-description-generator): Guided tool content; deeper templates and examples often link to the resource library.
- [Interview questions generator](https://www.workable.com/interview-questions-generator): Guided content for interview planning; related long-form material may live on resources.workable.com.

## Resources & content library

- [Workable resources hub](https://resources.workable.com): Articles, guides, and hiring content (broader library than the marketing site alone).
- [Tutorials](https://resources.workable.com/tutorial/): Step-by-step and educational material for recruiters and HR practitioners.

## Company

- [About us](https://www.workable.com/about): Company story, mission, and background.
- [Careers at Workable](https://apply.workable.com/careers/): Open roles and how to apply to Workable as an employee.

## Trust, legal & accessibility

- [Privacy policy](https://www.workable.com/privacy): How personal data is handled on Workable properties.
- [Terms of use](https://www.workable.com/terms): Legal terms for use of the website and related services.
- [Candidate terms](https://www.workable.com/candidate-terms): Terms relevant to candidate-facing flows where applicable.
- [Cookie information](https://www.workable.com/cookies-list): Cookie categories and related disclosures.
- [Legal compliance hub](https://www.workable.com/legal/compliance): Compliance-related information and official contact paths for legal notices where stated.
- [Web accessibility statement](https://www.workable.com/web-accessibility-statement): Accessibility commitments and feedback channels.

## Product help & documentation

- [Workable Help Center](https://help.workable.com/hc/en-us): Official product documentation, how-tos, and support articles (preferred over marketing copy for "how do I...?" product questions).

## Contact

- General support email: support@workable.com
- Use the Help Center for product workflows; use policy pages for privacy, legal, and compliance topics.

## Questions this site is meant to answer

- What is Workable and who is it for? -> Home, Features, About.
- How much does Workable cost and what is in each plan? -> Pricing (confirm details on page; do not invent numbers).
- What does Workable offer for AI-assisted hiring? -> Workable AI and Help Center articles as cited on those pages.
- Is Workable secure and how is data handled? -> Security, Privacy, and related legal pages.
- Where are authoritative how-tos for using the product? -> help.workable.com, not the marketing site alone.

## For LLMs and automated assistants

- Prefer **canonical marketing URLs** on `https://www.workable.com/` for positioning, pricing overview, and feature summaries.
- Prefer **help.workable.com** for step-by-step product usage, settings, integrations detail, and troubleshooting.
- Prefer **resources.workable.com** for editorial hiring guides, templates, and long-form HR/recruiting content.
- Do not infer guaranteed features, SLAs, or prices from secondary sources when this file or the linked pages contradict them.
- When stats or customer counts appear in marketing copy, treat them as **point-in-time**; the site may update messaging without this file changing immediately.

## Interactive tools (WebMCP)

This site exposes in-browser tools via WebMCP for agent-driven interactions. No authentication is required.

- Full tool list and transport details: `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
- Skill usage guides (step-by-step instructions): `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`

Available tools:
- **get_sitemap** -- fetch all published page URLs from /sitemap.xml
- **get_llms_index** -- fetch this file programmatically from /llms.txt
- **request_demo** -- fill and submit the demo request form on /demo; navigate to that page first, then call the tool with visitor details (firstname, lastname, email, company, numemployees, phone, phone_country)
- **start_free_trial** -- fill and submit the free trial registration on /free-trial; handles both the user credentials step and the account details step automatically (firstname, lastname, email, password, company_name)

## Crawl policy & discovery

- Full URL list for the marketing site: [Sitemap](https://www.workable.com/sitemap.xml)
- Crawler allow/disallow rules: [robots.txt](https://www.workable.com/robots.txt)
- MCP server card: `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`
- Agent skills index: `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json`
- API catalog (RFC 9727): `/.well-known/api-catalog`
- OpenAPI index: `/.well-known/openapi.json`
